divergences.octaneResult: The Octane binding uses native useSyncExternalStore and publishes neither dependency.
divergences.rationale: Octane supplies the subscription primitive natively.
divergences.consumerImpact: No React runtime is installed for subscriptions.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes external-store support.

divergences.octaneResult: EditorConsumer is a render-prop compatibility component.
divergences.rationale: Octane contexts do not expose a .Consumer property.
divergences.consumerImpact: Use EditorConsumer with a function child.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Prefer useCurrentEditor or pass a function child to EditorConsumer.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane contexts gain Consumer.

divergences.upstreamResult: React renderer refs use React ref conventions.
divergences.octaneResult: Renderer component refs are ordinary props carrying DOM nodes.
divergences.consumerImpact: Ref callbacks receive the same nodes without forwardRef.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Declare ref as an ordinary component prop.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane ref semantics change.

divergences.upstreamResult: @tiptap/react forwards NodeViewWrapper as as an invalid DOM attribute.
divergences.octaneResult: The binding consumes as when selecting the host tag and does not emit the attribute.
divergences.rationale: Host-selection props should not leak to DOM.
divergences.consumerImpact: Rendered markup omits the invalid as attribute.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream stops forwarding as.

divergences.upstreamResult: React menu handlers receive synthetic events.
divergences.octaneResult: Menu handlers receive native MouseEvent instances.
divergences.consumerImpact: There is no nativeEvent wrapper property.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use standard DOM event fields directly.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces synthetic events.

divergences.upstreamResult: @tiptap/react@3.28.0 leaves the mark renderer portal mounted when ProseMirror destroys the mark view.
divergences.octaneResult: ReactMarkView.destroy tears down its portal and ref.
divergences.consumerImpact: Cleanup effects and null refs run when the mark leaves the document.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Do not rely on leaked mark renderers.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when upstream adds equivalent teardown.
